guardrails: 38 agents total; each agent owns one KPI card and one purpose question.
Keep all nine verticals isolated; never mix their source PDFs, prompts, KPI data or customer records.
Shipping Agent, Commercial Rep and NVOCC are separate verticals with forbidden_mix rules.
Never invent rates, licenses, contracts, supplier approvals, bank receipts, or savings evidence.
Cash Collected is primary KPI. Cash = 0 until receipt evidence is verified.
